_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is real and sidelined ammo is building, but with 0/50 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves and the analyst's directional record at 0-for-18, forcing a directional call without the breaker visible is statistically reckless — HOLD wins when the score holds.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call HOLD on direction, but the Narrative is more structurally bullish on the bottoming thesis while the Analyst explicitly distrusts the analog; the split is on interpretation of the 74.5% match, not on the immediate action.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows recovers above 30 AND funding drops below 40 AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 85
next_move.invalidated_if: vix breaks above 80 AND etf_flows stays at 0 AND btc breaks $60k with exchange_netflow sustained at 100
